name: Agatha Christie - Murder on the Orient Express

locations.note: Poirot boards the Orient Express in Istanbul, as in the novel, with the story moved to 2023.
Joanna Locke's playable flashbacks: her years on Cassetti's trail since 2019 and the Armstrong kidnapping case in Boston.
Poirot and Locke leave the train and begin their investigation in the city.
Poirot and Locke work separately to get into a bank and open Cassetti's safety-deposit box.
The train's last destination, where the case is closed.

routes.name: Hercule Poirot and Joanna Locke
routes.note: Poirot boards the Orient Express in Istanbul, then steps off with Joanna Locke in Venice and Switzerland to chase Cassetti's money before the case closes in Paris.
